resources.string: Choose each readout independently. Enabled items stay at the top right, including while controls are hidden or locked.
This app’s share of all CPU cores, updated every 2 seconds while the player is visible.
Device GPU usage when driver counters are readable; otherwise unavailable. Does not measure dedicated video-decoder usage.
Actual video output frames per second, separate from source frame rate. Zero while paused; unavailable before preparation or for audio-only media.
Media data received per second. Local media shows —. Updates once a second; buffering can continue while paused.
